questions.stem: 許多試著戒菸的人很快就發現，由尼古丁（nicotine）引起的強烈渴望極難抗拒。
questions.answer: Many people who try to quit smoking soon find that the strong desire caused by nicotine is extremely hard to resist.
accepted_answers: Many smokers who are trying to quit soon find out that the strong urges caused by nicotine are extremely difficult to resist.
Many people trying to give up smoking quickly find that the strong urge that nicotine causes is extremely hard to resist.

patterns: 關係代名詞 who 引導的形容詞子句
分詞片語後位修飾（N + p.p.）

questions.stem: 許多專家認為，決定一個人能否成功戒菸最重要的因素，是家人和朋友的支持。
questions.answer: Many experts believe that the most important factor that determines whether a person can successfully quit smoking is support from family and friends.
accepted_answers: Many experts think that the most important factor in deciding whether someone can quit smoking successfully is the support of family and friends.
Many experts believe that the biggest factor deciding whether people can quit smoking successfully is the support they get from family and friends.

patterns: 間接問句（whether 名詞子句）

1.explanation_zh: 「試著戒菸的人」用關係子句 people who try to quit smoking（或分詞片語 people trying to quit）；quit 後面接動名詞 smoking。「由尼古丁引起的強烈渴望」用過去分詞片語後位修飾 the strong desire caused by nicotine（渴望是被引起的，所以用 caused）。「極難抗拒」用 is extremely hard to resist（主詞就是 resist 的受詞，句尾不再加 it）。
evidence: 由尼古丁（nicotine）引起的強烈渴望
1.strategy_zh: 名詞前的「…的」：主動用 N + V-ing，被動用 N + p.p.，較長或有時態就用 who／that 子句。
hints: 切成四段：許多試著戒菸的人／很快就發現／由尼古丁引起的強烈渴望／極難抗拒
標的詞彙：try（試著）、quit（戒除）、smoke（抽菸）、find（發現）、strong（強烈的）、desire（渴望）、cause（引起）、extremely（極度地）、hard（困難的）、resist（抗拒）
句型框架：Many people who + V … soon find that + the N + p.p. by … + is extremely hard to V

2.explanation_zh: 「許多專家認為」用 Many experts believe／think that …。「決定一個人能否成功戒菸最重要的因素」修飾語很長，英文先寫核心 the most important factor（最高級），再用關係子句 that determines whether … 或 in deciding whether … 往後修飾；「能否…」用 whether 名詞子句，直述句語序 whether a person can successfully quit smoking。主詞核心是 factor（單數），動詞用 is。
2.strategy_zh: 「是否／能否…」→ whether + S + (can) + V；「最＋形容詞＋的＋N」→ the most + adj. + N（後面的修飾語用子句往後放）。
hints: 切成四段：許多專家認為／決定一個人能否成功戒菸／最重要的因素／是家人和朋友的支持
標的詞彙：expert（專家）、believe（認為）、determine（決定）、successfully（成功地）、quit（戒除）、important（重要的）、factor（因素）、support（支持）、family（家人）、friend（朋友）
句型框架：Many experts believe that the most important factor that determines whether + S + can + V … is + N

references: Many people who try to quit smoking soon find that the strong desire caused by nicotine is extremely hard to resist.
Many smokers who are trying to quit soon find out that the strong urges caused by nicotine are extremely difficult to resist.
Many people trying to give up smoking quickly find that the strong urge that nicotine causes is extremely hard to resist.

patterns.label_zh: 關係代名詞 who 引導的限定子句（試著戒菸的人）
分詞片語後位修飾名詞（由尼古丁引起的…）
patterns.frame: N + p.p. + by …（被動）／ N + V-ing …（主動）
patterns.zh_trigger: 由尼古丁（nicotine）引起的強烈渴望

accepted: Many people who try to quit smoking
Many smokers who are trying to quit
Many people trying to give up smoking
Many people who are trying to quit smoking
Many smokers trying to quit

common_errors.wrong: Many people who try to quit smoke
common_errors.right: Many people who try to quit smoking
common_errors.explanation_zh: quit 後面接動名詞 smoking（戒掉…）；quit smoke 文法不對。

common_errors.wrong: Many people try to quit smoking soon find
common_errors.right: Many people who try to quit smoking soon find
common_errors.explanation_zh: 一句不能有兩個主要動詞（try、find）；「試著戒菸的」要用 who 子句或分詞片語 trying to quit 修飾 people。

accepted: soon find that
soon find out that
quickly find that
soon discover that

common_errors.explanation_zh: 主詞 many people 是複數，動詞 find 不加 s。
時間副詞 soon 放在一般動詞前面：soon find。

parts.zh: 由尼古丁（nicotine）引起的強烈渴望
accepted: the strong desire caused by nicotine
the strong urges caused by nicotine
the strong cravings caused by nicotine
the strong urge that nicotine causes
the strong desire that nicotine causes
the strong craving caused by nicotine

common_errors.wrong: the strong desire causing by nicotine
common_errors.right: the strong desire caused by nicotine
common_errors.explanation_zh: 渴望是「被」尼古丁引起的，用過去分詞 caused by；causing 表主動。

common_errors.wrong: the by nicotine caused strong desire
common_errors.right: the strong desire caused by nicotine
common_errors.explanation_zh: 中文「由尼古丁引起的」在名詞前，英文要用分詞片語放在名詞後面修飾。

accepted: is extremely hard to resist
are extremely difficult to resist
is extremely difficult to resist

common_errors.wrong: is extremely hard to resist it
common_errors.explanation_zh: 主詞 the strong desire 就是 resist 的受詞，句尾不可再加 it。

common_errors.wrong: is extremely hard to be resisted
common_errors.explanation_zh: hard to V 的句型用主動不定詞 to resist，不用被動。

traps.literal_error: Many try to quit smoking people soon find …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「試著戒菸的」放在「人」前面，英文要先寫 people，再用 who 子句或分詞片語往後修飾：people who try to quit smoking／people trying to quit。

traps.literal_error: … nicotine makes people strongly want, which is very hard to resist
traps.explanation_zh: 「渴望」在這裡是名詞（想抽菸的慾望），用 desire／craving／urge；寫成動詞 want，句子就接不上「極難抗拒」的主詞。

bonus.text: Many would-be quitters soon learn that the cravings nicotine triggers are almost impossible to fight off.
bonus.explanation_zh: would-be quitters（想戒的人）、trigger（引發）、fight off（擊退）都是生動用法；the cravings nicotine triggers 是省略關代的形容詞子句。這是加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「由尼古丁引起的強烈渴望」中文修飾語在前，英文改成分詞片語後位修飾 the strong desire caused by nicotine；「試著戒菸的人」改成 people who try to quit smoking。

references: Many experts believe that the most important factor that determines whether a person can successfully quit smoking is support from family and friends.
Many experts think that the most important factor in deciding whether someone can quit smoking successfully is the support of family and friends.
Many experts believe that the biggest factor deciding whether people can quit smoking successfully is the support they get from family and friends.

patterns.label_zh: 間接問句：whether 名詞子句（能否…）

accepted: Many experts believe that
Many experts think that
Many experts hold that

common_errors.explanation_zh: many 後面接複數名詞 experts。
believe 是一般動詞，前面不加 be 動詞。

parts.zh: 決定一個人能否成功戒菸
accepted: determines whether a person can successfully quit smoking
in deciding whether someone can quit smoking successfully
deciding whether people can quit smoking successfully
determines whether someone can quit smoking successfully

common_errors.wrong: determines whether can a person quit smoking
common_errors.right: determines whether a person can quit smoking
common_errors.explanation_zh: whether 名詞子句用直述句語序：whether + 主詞 + can + V。

common_errors.wrong: determines whether a person can successfully quit smoke
common_errors.right: determines whether a person can successfully quit smoking
common_errors.explanation_zh: quit 後面接動名詞 smoking。

accepted: the most important factor
the biggest factor
the key factor

common_errors.explanation_zh: 修飾名詞 factor 要用形容詞 important；importance 是名詞。
「最重要的」是最高級 the most important，不是比較級。

accepted: is support from family and friends
is the support of family and friends
is the support they get from family and friends
is the support from family and friends

common_errors.wrong: is the support from family and friend
common_errors.right: is the support from family and friends
common_errors.explanation_zh: 朋友不只一位，用複數 friends。

common_errors.wrong: are support from family and friends
common_errors.right: is support from family and friends
common_errors.explanation_zh: 主詞核心是 the most important factor（單數），動詞用 is。

traps.literal_error: … whether can a person successfully quit smoke …
traps.explanation_zh: 「能否…」要寫成 whether 名詞子句，語序是 whether + 主詞 + can + V（不倒裝）；「戒菸」是 quit smoking。

traps.zh: 決定一個人能否成功戒菸最重要的因素
traps.literal_error: the determine a person can quit smoking most important factor
traps.explanation_zh: 中文修飾語「決定…的」放在「因素」前面，英文要先寫 the most important factor，再用 that determines whether … 或 in deciding whether … 往後修飾。

bonus.text: Many experts believe that nothing determines whether a smoker can kick the habit more than the support of family and friends.
bonus.explanation_zh: nothing … more than …（沒有什麼比…更…）用否定加比較級表達最高級；kick the habit（戒除習慣）是道地說法。這是加分寫法。

1.translation: Many people who try to quit smoking soon find that the strong cravings caused by nicotine are extremely hard to resist.
1.explanation_zh: 「許多試著戒菸的人」用關係子句 who try to quit smoking；「很快就發現」用 soon find that；「由尼古丁引起的強烈渴望」用過去分詞片語 caused by nicotine 後位修飾；「渴望」用 cravings（學測程度也可用 desire）；「極難抗拒」用 extremely hard to resist。

2.translation: Many experts believe that the most important factor that determines whether a person can quit smoking successfully is support from family and friends.
2.explanation_zh: 「許多專家認為」用 believe that；「決定一個人能否成功戒菸」用關係子句 that determines＋whether 名詞子句；「最重要的因素」用最高級 the most important factor；「家人和朋友的支持」用 support from family and friends。

1.translation: Many people who try to quit smoking soon find that the strong cravings caused by nicotine are extremely hard to resist.
1.explanation_zh: 「許多試著戒菸的人」用關係子句 who try to quit smoking；「很快就發現」用 soon find that ...；「由尼古丁引起的強烈渴望」用 cravings caused by nicotine（過去分詞後飾）；「極難抗拒」用 extremely hard to resist。

2.translation: Many experts believe that the most important factor in determining whether a person can quit smoking successfully is support from family and friends.
2.explanation_zh: 「許多專家認為」用 Many experts believe that ...；「決定一個人能否成功戒菸最重要的因素」用 the most important factor in determining whether ...；「家人和朋友的支持」用 support from family and friends。

issues_zh: 第 3 部分 targets 標 PART（分詞片語後位修飾），但 accepted 與 REF2 的 the strong urge(s)／desire that nicotine causes 是關係子句、不是分詞；學生這樣寫正確，但沒有用到標的句型。
第 3 部分 targets 標 COMP（最高級），但 accepted 的 the key factor 不是最高級，也沒有 important；學生寫 key factor 會被接受，卻沒有用到標的句型。
